questions: What specific concurrency primitives does the repository provide, and what are their behaviours, transitions, guards, timeouts, retries, cancellation, failures, and invariants?
Lines 5-6 state the repository provides primitives in addition to language and standard packages, but do not enumerate them; what set of primitives is in scope?
The source specifies Gerrit for code changes and gives a contribution link, but does not state any ordering between reporting an issue and sending a patch; is there a required sequence?
Line 16 specifies a subject-line prefix for issues but does not state whether it is mandatory or optional, nor what happens if it is omitted.
Line 15 calls https://go.dev/issues the "main" issue tracker but does not define other trackers or when alternative ones apply.
No seam contracts, internal events, side effects, timeouts, or failure handling for the primitives are described in the source; are these documented elsewhere?
